title: Pluggable block store: Kubo/S3/filesystem backends
description:
Abstract the IPFS block store behind a trait so the backend can be selected via config.

Why this issue exists:
IpfsStore is currently hardwired to the Kubo HTTP client. Operators need to choose between Kubo (local IPFS node), S3-compatible object storage, and a local filesystem backend without recompiling.

What needs to be done:
- Add delete() to IpfsStore and IpfsBlockStore traits
- [backend] config section and serde enum (kubo / s3 / filesystem)
- Factory functions in transit and reader that instantiate the configured backend
- LMDB backend: concurrent read test and delete test
- Migration note and RUNBOOK update
